### [`leftover_source_text`](../../../src/sprite_data.asm#L6) `$5900-$59A4`

*data*

Apple II Merlin assembler source text ('DFB $F0,$C0', '* CHAR 97'), ASCII with bit 7 set. Not used by the game code.

<a id="frame_src_lo"></a>
### [`frame_src_lo`](../../../src/sprite_data.asm#L43) `$59BD-$5A8E`

*data*

Frame graphics pointers, 210 low bytes then 210 high bytes; 0 = no graphics. Frames 0-69 Bruce Lee, 70-139 Yamo, 140-209 Ninja; frames f and f+1 (f even) are the two sprite layers of one picture.

- **Referred to by:** [`setup_frame_source`](sprite_render.md#setup_frame_source) [`$2719`](../../../src/sprite_render.asm#L252), [`build_frame_mask`](collision.md#build_frame_mask) [`$517E`](../../../src/collision.asm#L65)
